newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore says it now has over 500 HIV, AIDS cases.
newsitem.headline: Singapore says it now has over 500 HIV, AIDS cases.

text.p: The number of people infected with the HIV virus and cases of full-blown AIDS has risen to more than 500 in Singapore, the Health Ministry said on Friday.
The ministry did not give a breakdown of infections and cases of AIDS, but said the main means of transmission of the killer disease is heterosexual sex.

Health experts have warned that the AIDS epidemic is mushrooming in Asia, with up to a million new victims in Indonesia and 300,000 people infected with HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) in Vietnam by 2000.
About 800,000 Thais currently have HIV and the number of those infected is expected to rise to more than one million by 2000, the Thai Health Ministry said.

The World Health Organisation estimates that nearly 28 million people have been infected worldwide with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, since the start of the epidemic 15 years ago. An additional 26 million may be infected by 2000.
